CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Observe whether a recommendations container appears on PDP pages where the feature is expected.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
1. Open several PDPs across different categories.
2. Note if and where a recommendations container appears.
3. Record any missing or unstable rendering.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Container behavior is observable and consistent for the sampled PDPs.
No broken layout artifact is observed in the module area.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Observe whether recommendation content appears to change when switching between clearly different PDP contexts.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
1. Open two or more PDPs with distinct context (for example category or brand).
2. Capture visible recommendation outputs for each page.
3. Compare for obvious staleness or no-change behavior.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Observed output is not obviously stale across context changes.
Any ambiguous behavior is recorded for product clarification.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Observe page behavior when recommendation data is absent or not returned.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
1. Open PDPs likely to have sparse recommendation data.
2. Inspect module area and surrounding layout.
3. Record placeholder, spacing, or broken-state artifacts.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
PDP remains usable when recommendation content is absent.
No customer-facing technical error message is shown.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Observe high-level recommendation module behavior across NAP and MRP storefronts.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify:
1. Open similar PDPs on net-a-porter and mrporter.
2. Compare recommendation area placement and baseline rendering quality.
3. Record notable deviations for triage.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
No severe rendering defect is observed in either storefront sample.
Differences are captured as observations, not treated as pass/fail AC without product guidance.
